[!isolates] skip
# An external module supplies typed adapters through an explicit generic manifest.
# Compiler-owned descriptors and state factories never cross the public API.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o check$GOEXE ./host
exec ./check$GOEXE
stdout '^private initialization and generated invocation passed$'
# Source contents, rather than the temporary manifest path, define cache identity.
cp isolate.json other.json
go build -isolate-config=other.json -o cached$GOEXE ./host
exec ./cached$GOEXE
stdout '^private initialization and generated invocation passed$'
# The adapter cannot acquire internal imports through the build hook.
cp invalid.json other.json
! go build -isolate-config=other.json -o invalid$GOEXE ./host
stderr 'adds unsupported import "internal/isolatebridge"'
# The core checks adapter provenance and its call ABI before registration.
cp bad-accessor.json other.json
! go build -isolate-config=other.json ./host
stderr 'accessor entryValue must return the selected function Entry directly'
cp bad-abi.json other.json
! go build -isolate-config=other.json -o bad-abi$GOEXE ./host
stderr 'cannot use entryInvoke'
# An invalid manifest must fail before constructing a program.
cp version.json other.json
! go build -isolate-config=other.json ./host
stderr 'unsupported format version 100'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/manifest
go 1.26
-- isolate.json --
{
 "format_version":1,
 "entries":[{"package":"example.org/manifest/jobs","function":"Entry","value":"entryValue","invoke":"entryInvoke"}],
 "state_packages":["example.org/manifest/jobs"],
 "sources":{"example.org/manifest/jobs":"package jobs\nimport (\"isolate\"; _ \"unsafe\")\n//go:linkname entryValue\nfunc entryValue() any {return Entry}\n//go:linkname entryInvoke\nfunc entryInvoke(decode,encode func(...isolate.Value)error)error {if err:=decode();err!=nil{return err};v:=Entry();return encode(isolate.Value{Value:v,Pointer:&v})}\n"}
}
-- invalid.json --
{
 "format_version":1,
 "entries":[{"package":"example.org/manifest/jobs","function":"Entry","value":"entryValue","invoke":"entryInvoke"}],
 "sources":{"example.org/manifest/jobs":"package jobs\nimport _ \"internal/isolatebridge\"\n"}
}
-- version.json --
{"format_version":100}
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
var count=40
func init(){count++}
var graph=func()struct{count *int;values map[string]int;read func()int}{
 p:=new(int)
 return struct{count *int;values map[string]int;read func()int}{p,map[string]int{"n":0},func()int{return *p}}
}()
func Entry() int {
 count++;*graph.count++;graph.values["n"]++
 if graph.read()!=1||graph.values["n"]!=1{panic("initialized graph leaked")}
 return count
}
func HostCount()int{if *graph.count!=0||graph.values["n"]!=0{panic("host graph changed")};return count}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "example.org/manifest/jobs"
)
func dispatch(h isolate.Handle) {
 if err:=h.Invoke(func(...isolate.Value)error{return nil},func(values ...isolate.Value)error {
  if len(values)!=1 || values[0].Value.(int)!=42 {panic("instance state leaked")}
  _,err:=isolate.Call(1,[]byte("ok"));return err
 });err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
func main(){
 h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Entry);if !ok {panic("entry missing")}
 for range 2 {
  i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithHandle(dispatch)});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
  if err=i.Start();err!=nil{panic(err)}
  select {
  case c:=<-i.Commands():
   if string(c.Payload)!="ok" {panic("wrong result")};c.Reply(nil,nil)
  case <-i.Done():panic(i.Wait())
  }
  if err=i.Wait();err!=nil{panic(err)}
 }
 if jobs.HostCount()!=41 {panic("host initialization changed")}
 fmt.Println("private initialization and generated invocation passed")
}

{"format_version":1,"entries":[{"package":"example.org/manifest/jobs","function":"Entry","value":"entryValue","invoke":"entryInvoke"}],"sources":{"example.org/manifest/jobs":"package jobs\nimport \"isolate\"\nfunc entryValue()any{return func(){}}\nfunc entryInvoke(decode,encode func(...isolate.Value)error)error{return nil}\n"}}

{"format_version":1,"entries":[{"package":"example.org/manifest/jobs","function":"Entry","value":"entryValue","invoke":"entryInvoke"}],"sources":{"example.org/manifest/jobs":"package jobs\nimport(\"isolate\";_ \"unsafe\")\n//go:linkname entryValue\nfunc entryValue()any{return Entry}\n//go:linkname entryInvoke\nfunc entryInvoke(){}\n"}}
